song.name: The Vow
song.plot: The trilogy finale. The survivors arrive in Eldoria; the dawn breaks. Seraphina makes the vow to build New Ravenspire, to honor Anya's sacrifice and free her one day. The trilogy ends at the dawn — the promise, not the founding (founding is Era III, Queen of Carnage).
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Seraphina (or Seraphina + the survivors, "we"), first person/first person plural. Anchors: Eldoria (material plane), the dawn, Anya's sacrifice, the vow to build New Ravenspire and to one day free her, the promise of the living lock. Ends AT the dawn — NOT the formal founding (that is Era III/~150 AGD, Queen of Carnage). Media-model clean; no meta. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro. Soaring, warm, conclusive yet forward-looking. Suggested Suno direction: triumphant dawn anthem — bright strings, rising major-key choir, bells, the darkness lifting into golden resolve.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: We crossed the storm and came into the light, We left the ashes of the endless night. And as the first true dawn began to burn, I swore a vow to the ones who could not turn.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: This is the vow, upon the Dawn, We will build a home that will not fawn. For the warden in the shadow's keep, We will find a way to break the deep.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: I will raise New Ravenspire from the dust, A city forged to guard the light we trust. And I will not forget her lonely shade, The soul the dark has taken, unpaid.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: This is the vow, upon the Dawn, We will build a home that will not fawn. For the warden in the shadow's keep, We will find a way to break the deep.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: Not an ending, but a start, A promise written on this land. We will not let the seal be dark, We will come back, and take her hand.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: This is the vow, upon the Dawn, We will build a home that will not fawn. For the warden in the shadow's keep, We will find a way to break the deep.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: The Dawn has come, the Legion's run, We make the vow beneath the sun. New Ravenspire shall rise and shine, And Anya, we are coming... we are coming.
